name: RippleGrid-TS-TW

frames.best_why: The ripple is at its fullest, bowing the white grid into a clear dome around the cursor.

tagline: A white wireframe grid pulses and warps around the cursor.
summary: A WebGL grid of thin white lines on black keeps rippling outward, brightest at the middle and fading into darkness at the edges. The pointer adds a local wave so the grid bends around it.
appearance: A white wireframe grid sits on black, bowing outward from the centre so it reads like a stretched net. Lines are brightest in the middle and fade to black toward the corners.
behaviour: A pulse keeps travelling out from the centre, bending the grid and letting it spring back. Under the pointer a local wave shifts the lines so the net warps around the cursor.
demo_content: White grid on black with 10px cells, thickness 15 and mouse warp enabled.
search_phrases: grid that waves with the mouse
pulsing net background for a hero
use_when: A dark tech or AI hero needs a spatial grid that reacts to the pointer.
avoid_when: Thin bright lines on black are hard to read text over and glare on bright screens.
customise: Colour, rainbow mode, ripple strength, cell size, line thickness, glow, fade, vignette and rotation are all props.
weight_why: A full-screen shader is redrawn on every animation frame.

a11y.note: A canvas backdrop with no labels; the endless ripple ignores reduced-motion settings.

polish_why: Crisp, convincing ripple with a bright centre; the grid fades early and only one colour shows.
title: Ripple Grid
